doc.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019

title: Current work with Harry Connick
summary: Upcoming projects including Connick's Cole Porter show and a film soundtrack; he has been with Connick nearly twenty years.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s in the near future besides playing at Hamilton College tomorrow?

Well I just got done with the week with Harry Connick. He’s got a new Cole Porter thing, show that he’s putting together and a record coming out, and then I’m working on this soundtrack for this movie, and just a bunch of local gigs around New York, some stuff with my trio, and tomorrow night.
How long have you been with Harry Connick?
I wonder if you played in Utica because he was here a number of years ago.
Yeah. I’ve been with him almost like twenty years or something.
Yeah. That was the first time I saw a band using —
Computer charts, yeah. I remember it was a great concert.
